This project's AI-agent guidance lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) 
at the repository root. Read `AGENTS.md` first - it is the
entrypoint and lists all available skills; skills under `/skills/` are loaded on demand.

Do not duplicate that guidance here. If you need to change what agents are told, edit `AGENTS.md`
or the relevant skill under `/skills/`, not this file.
